purpose: Hand-packed reference vectors for the packing and kernel gates in docs/ternary-format-v1.md.

files.packed.safetensors: demo.weight packed per v1 ([5,128] source -> codes [5,32] + scales [5,1]) plus dense.weight [5] F32 and __metadata__.
files.vectors.json: Per-row input weights, expected codes (hex + list), expected scales, expected dequantized output.

row_behaviors.0: all-zero group: scale 0, all codes 1 (0x55 bytes)
row_behaviors.1: +d first half, -d second half: codes 2 then 0
row_behaviors.2: [d,-d,0,0.5d] quarter pattern: 0.5d rounds to +d (worked example in spec)
row_behaviors.4: non-unit fp16 scale d=1.5: [1.5,-1.5,0,0.75]->[d,-d,0,0.5d] same codes as row 2

notes: Generated deterministically by a throwaway script. Asserts the spec byte order: weight j at bits 2*(j%4) of byte j/4.
